description: Facebook 584 — 98 patches with Vietnamese UI, Following feed by default, save photos by default + hide tab bar on the Reels tab (on by default; hiding gives the bar's space back, a tap or swipe brings it back for three seconds) + experimental: push the video to the top when comments open (settings > Comments) + new experimental patch: split the screen half and half when comments open on Reels (on by default, settings > Comments) + new switch: tab bar background more transparent, about half of Facebook's own alpha (on by default, settings > Appearance); quiet preset.
